News and events

Keep up to date with council latest news, events and notifications for Tauranga.

  • Public notices
    You can make a submission or object to applications for notified resource consents, alcohol licence applications and more.
  • Road closures
    Roads need to be closed for various reasons, but mainly for maintenance, construction work, and events.
  • Water shutdowns
    Details for all planned water shutdowns.
  • Wastewater overflow notifications
    Wastewater overflows pose a serious risk to public health and our environment and need to be fixed immediately.
  • Agrichemical applications
    A list of planned agrichemical applications in Tauranga.
  • Newsbeat - Our latest news
    Keep up to date with council's latest news and media releases for Tauranga.
  • What's On Tauranga
    View upcoming events throughout the city on What's On Tauranga.
  • Events
    Events are strong contributors to a region’s cultural identity and economic and social wellbeing.
  • Council meetings
    Find the dates and agendas for upcoming Council and committee meetings.
  • Newsletters
    View and subscribe to our collection of newsletters.
  • Notified tenders
    If you are a supplier and you want to work with council, see our list of tenders.
  • Media release archive
    A list of media releases published prior to 1 July 2024. For our latest news, visit Newsbeat.
